about.headline: The Team Behind CaliDev
about.subheadline: Business strategy and engineering under one roof. We build solutions that create real impact — without creating dependency.
about.mission_desc: To deliver technology solutions that create real business impact — without creating dependency. We build what you need, hand it over, and only stay if it makes sense for your business.
about.vision_desc: To become the go-to partner for SMBs and startups that want honest, results-driven technology consulting — where strategy and engineering work together from day one.
about.phil_desc: Most agencies want to become another monthly bill. We don't. If your problem is solved with a tool that runs locally — that's what we build, and we're done. No subscriptions, no artificial dependency.
about.phil_lockin_desc: You own everything we build. Full code, full access, no proprietary traps. Walk away whenever you want — with everything in hand.
about.phil_pay_title: Pay Only for What You Need
about.phil_pay_desc: A simple landing page? Starting at €600 and done. Complex system that needs ongoing support? We scale together. You decide.
about.phil_honest_desc: If you don't need us, we'll tell you. We'd rather earn your trust than your subscription. That's how we get referrals.
about.team_sub: A finance strategist and a systems engineer — the rare combination of business thinking and technical depth.
about.team_victor_bio: Finance (Universidad ICESI) · Data Analytics (Ironhack Barcelona). 3 years scaling a marketing startup across 10+ countries. 3 years as Data & AI Manager at Welcome Hotels chain. Victor leads strategy, business analysis, and AI implementation.
about.team_karen_bio: Systems Engineer. Full-stack development, technical architecture, and infrastructure. Karen turns strategy into production-ready systems that scale.
about.results_sub: Not hypothetical case studies. These are businesses we've worked with and the outcomes they achieved.
about.t_limpia_text: Before CaliDev, we managed everything in spreadsheets — payroll, bookings, client data. Victor didn't just build us an app. He analyzed our entire operation, found where we were losing money, and built a CRM that gave us 27 hours back every week.
about.t_cubiko_role: CEO, Cubiko Colombia → acquired by Dropi
about.t_cubiko_text: CaliDev helped us design a product strategy using Google's API to analyze Meta Ads performance — predicting which ads would succeed before spending the budget. The product showed so much potential that we were acquired by Dropi, one of Colombia's largest e-commerce conglomerates.
about.cta_desc: 30 minutes. No sales pitch. Just an honest conversation about your challenges and whether we can help.
